scope: Window collection count after loading an Excel-authored saved multi-view workbook. Full captured viewport observations are retained for further tests; this count probe does not certify the complete Window API.
program:
Attribute VB_Name = "ColdViewProbe"
Public Function Probe() As Long
 Probe = ThisWorkbook.Windows.Count
End Function

atomic_vba.scope: One to five saved views, sampled inside a VBA call in fresh Excel processes; two repeats each. All four histories are retained. Mode 3 explicitly normalizes the application window state and pumps its pending notifications.
atomic_vba.program:
Attribute VB_Name = "SavedViews1912"
Public Function Captions() As Variant
 Dim n As Long, i As Long, v() As Variant, w As Window
 n = ThisWorkbook.Windows.Count
 ReDim v(0 To n * 2)
 v(0) = n
 For i = 1 To n
  Set w = ThisWorkbook.Windows(i)
  v(i * 2 - 1) = w.Caption
  v(i * 2) = w.WindowNumber
 Next
 Captions = v
End Function
Public Function Probe(ByVal mode As Long) As Variant
 Dim n As Long, i As Long, at As Long, v() As Variant, w As Window, held() As Window
 If mode = 1 Then DoEvents
 If mode = 3 Then
  Application.WindowState = -4143
  DoEvents
 End If
 n = ThisWorkbook.Windows.Count
 ReDim v(0 To n * 14)
 ReDim held(1 To n)
 If mode = 2 Then
  For i = 1 To n
   Set held(i) = ThisWorkbook.Windows(i)
  Next
 End If
 v(0) = n
 For i = 1 To n
  If mode = 2 Then
   Set w = held(i)
  Else
   Set w = ThisWorkbook.Windows(i)
  End If
  at = (i - 1) * 14 + 1
  v(at) = w.Caption
  v(at + 1) = w.WindowNumber
  v(at + 2) = w.WindowState
  v(at + 3) = w.Visible
  v(at + 4) = w.ActiveSheet.Name
  v(at + 5) = w.Zoom
  v(at + 6) = w.RangeSelection.Address
  v(at + 7) = w.ScrollRow
  v(at + 8) = w.ScrollColumn
  v(at + 9) = w.FreezePanes
  v(at + 10) = w.SplitRow
  v(at + 11) = w.SplitColumn
  v(at + 12) = w.DisplayGridlines
  v(at + 13) = w.DisplayWorkbookTabs
 Next
 Probe = v
End Function
